verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Madrid's Salamanca district, on the Golden Mile, surrounded by luxury boutiques, restaurants and art galleries.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the exclusive Salamanca district, on Madrid’s Golden Mile, surrounded by luxury boutiques, restaurants and art galleries.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is Calle de Velazquez 62 in Madrid.
The hotel has a rooftop pool with views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designer rooms and suites, a rooftop pool with privileged views, a spa, a fitness center

verified_facts.text: The hotel's dining spaces are Picos Pardos Sky Lounge, Pinzelada Lounge, Blessed Breakfast and SLVJ.
verified_facts.excerpt: in each one of our gastronomic spaces: Picos Pardos Sky Lounge, Pinzelada Lounge, Blessed Breakfast and SLVJ.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers treatments by Beldon Wellness.
verified_facts.excerpt: be captivated by the exclusive treatments of Beldon Wellness in the Spa

verified_facts.text: The Wellbeing Terrace Villa is equipped with a jacuzzi and Hogo Beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy absolute serenity on the Wellbeing Terrace Villa, equipped with a jacuzzi and the innovative Hogo Beds

verified_facts.text: Pinzelada Lounge hosts art in a collection created with the Maria Porto gallery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pinzelada Lounge hosts artistic creations from relevant profiles from the world of art, thereby creating a collection with the renowned María Porto gallery.

verified_facts.text: Pinzelada Lounge holds DJ sessions with signature cocktails on several evenings a week, called Sips and Sounds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy the best DJ sessions and a curated selection of signature cocktails every Wednsday, Thursday and Saturday from 7:00 PM at Pinzelada Lounge.

verified_facts.text: Hosted by is a hosted evening in which a menu created for the occasion is paired with an exhibition or fashion show.
verified_facts.excerpt: A menu created exclusively for the occasion is designed to awaken the senses, while the experiential aspect comes alive through an exhibition or fashion show

verified_facts.text: Through a collaboration with La Finca Golf, the hotel offers its guests access to the course.
verified_facts.excerpt: BLESS Hotel Madrid, in collaboration with La Finca Golf, offers its guests exclusive access to one of Spain's most prestigious courses.

verified_facts.text: The entrance opens onto an Art Deco bar and lounge with Oriental rugs and Murano glass pieces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Doormen swing open glass doors to reveal an Art Deco bar and lounge with Oriental rugs, posh seating areas, Murano glass pieces

verified_facts.text: The hotel operates under the Palladium Hotel Group.
verified_facts.excerpt: BLESS Hotel Madrid now operates under the Palladium Hotel Group

verified_facts.text: Colon and the Paseo de la Castellana are within walking distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Colón and the Paseo de la Castellana are within walking distance.

verified_facts.text: Reception is tucked away in a corner, past the bar and lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: But you won’t recognize that this is a hotel until you find the path to reception, which is tucked away in a corner.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes that traditionalists may find the entrance through the bar and lounge a bit disjointed.
verified_facts.excerpt: Traditionalists will find the entrance—through the bar and lounge—a bit disjointed.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have hardwood floors with area rugs and residential touches like faux fireplaces and crown molding.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms have hardwood floors with area rugs, massive beds with plump duvets, and residential touches like faux fireplaces and crown molding.
